description: Meme built around a close-up photograph of Mark Zuckerberg with a shocked, open-mouthed expression. Caption above declares Q was right and pain is coming; below, headline-style text references a Facebook stock plunge of 24 percent, with a partially cropped Drudge Report logo at the bottom edge and an imgflip.com watermark in the lower-left corner. The meme frames the July 2018 Facebook stock drop as vindication of Q predictions.
text: OH SHIT, Q WAS RIGHT. NOW HERE COMES THE PAIN. FACEBOOK DEATH SPIRAL. STOCK PLUNGES 24%. DRUDGE REPORT. imgflip.com
